caption: The drawing depicts a woman in an elaborate historical gown primarily in shades of pink and white. The main figure is shown facing forward, wearing a floor-length dress with a fitted bodice, a wide neckline adorned with white lace trim, and elbow-length sleeves that end in flared lace cuffs. The dress features a pink floral pattern with white details, and an open front reveals an underdress or petticoat in a pale, almost white color with subtle beige and gray shadows. The woman’s hair is styled close to the head and she holds a closed fan in her right hand. To the upper left of the main figure is a smaller sketch of the woman from the back, highlighting the fullness of the gown and its train. To the left of the main figure is a detailed black-and-white sketch of an embroidered or lace pattern, possibly an element of the dress. The entire composition is done on a beige or off-white background, and the outlines are rendered in black ink with watercolor washes for color.
title: Dress
